spec.title: Setup: build Guava #7277's two revisions (JRE and Android) and run FuturesTest
spec.description: Setup for case L16 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief.md, no claims. The PR changes AggregateFuture in both Guava flavours and adds no tests. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/worktrees (L16-guava-fix = dc80e7e9f3844381aacc93ee1e043a711f1feffb, L16-guava-parent = 8c31d52687cf03346635e29b3c5529e183c3f6ee), runs Guava's Maven build (JDK 21, Maven 3.10.0, the cache's local repository, user.home redirected into the cache) for guava-tests with -am, JRE and Android flavours, running the existing FuturesTest (allAsList, ordering, cancellation): fix online (one connector thread), parent offline, fix JRE again offline. Copies each built guava jar to the cache with the digests of its AggregateFuture classes. Compiling guava-testlib and guava-tests is why this is a job. Logs and JUnit summaries to ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/logs; worktrees cleaned. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief-setup.md.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: FuturesTest passes on both revisions in both flavours, online and offline; four jars copied
